description: Scalar coercion follows PHP: booleans accept true/false, 0/1 and "0"/"1"; numbers accept numeric strings; selects accept numbers; null scalars become empty.

cases.name: Boolean accepts the string "1" as true
Boolean accepts the string "0" as false
Boolean accepts the number 1 as true
Boolean accepts the number 0 as false
Boolean rejects the word "true"

expect.reason: PHP in_array strict list: true, false, 0, 1, '0', '1'

cases.name: Boolean rejects null

expect.reason: null is not in the boolean list

cases.name: Boolean rejects an empty string

expect.reason: '' is not in the boolean list

cases.name: Boolean rejects the JSON float 1.0

expect.reason: PHP json_decode keeps 1.0 a float, which is not in the strict boolean list
